0022600155.text: The Pacers (2-4, 0-2 at home) host the Brooklyn Nets (0-5) on a three-game losing streak for Indiana and a five-game skid for Brooklyn, with the Pacers 3rd in the Central, 3 games back, and 12th in the East, while the Nets sit 5th in the Atlantic and 15th in the East. Indiana is missing Tyrese Haliburton (hamstring strain), Ivica Zubac (ankle sprain), Ben Sheppard (knee), Johnny Furphy (knee surgery), and T.J. McConnell (hamstring strain), and Aaron Nesmith (hamstring strain) and Obi Toppin (back soreness) are day-to-day and game-time decisions, while Brooklyn is without Egor Demin (leg bruise), Mikel Brown Jr. (rest), and Tyler Bilodeau (shoulder sprain). The Pacers lead the 2026-27 season series 1-0 after their 136-109 win in Brooklyn on October 25, and they also won the 2025-26 series 2-1.
